conceptRationale: The symbol interprets a welcoming O as two broad, opposing curved bands. The two open side gaps suggest connection and invitation without closing the mark at small sizes.
geometryRationale: The symbol uses two original cubic Bézier arcs with rounded caps. Their deliberately separated side endpoints preserve two readable openings. The lowercase wordmark is custom filled vector geometry for o-o-r-v-a, not a font rendering or traced outline.

originalityProvenance.authorship: Original Bézier symbol and custom lowercase letter paths authored for this Oorva candidate. No third-party mark was copied or traced.
originalityProvenance.inputUse: Unapproved PNG explorations were reviewed only for the Connected O direction and color intent; no raster was embedded or traced.
originalityProvenance.wordmarkConstruction: Hand-authored lowercase vector paths; all master files contain no live text, font, or external resource.

smallSizeEvidence.method: The symbol SVG's two path endpoint pairs are measured from their actual M/C path data; rounded stroke caps are included by subtracting half of each path stroke width from endpoint separation. The resultant vector gap is scaled by logicalSize / 256.
smallSizeEvidence.gapFormula: gapUnits = abs(upperEndpointY - lowerEndpointY) - (upperStrokeWidth + lowerStrokeWidth) / 2; gapPx = gapUnits * logicalSizePx / sourceViewBoxWidth
smallSizeEvidence.visualInspection: Endpoint geometry remains separated at each requested size. The 20px test has a 3.4375px computed opening on both sides; no raster export or device rendering is claimed by this stage.

tagline.placement: Separate app text; not part of SVG wordmark geometry or any SVG master.
tagline.fontSource: Bundled Inter 400 for separate tagline rendering; runtime font loading is not validated by O01L.

contrastEvidence.standard: WCAG relative luminance and contrast ratio for sRGB colors
contrastEvidence.channelLinearization: cLinear = cSrgb / 12.92 when cSrgb <= 0.04045; otherwise ((cSrgb + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4, where cSrgb is the 0-1 channel value.

license.customArtwork: Original project candidate authored in this task; no third-party vector or raster paths were copied. Ownership, trademark, public-use and redistribution clearance are not asserted; D03c remains pending.
license.taglineFont: Bundled Inter Regular 400 is referenced only as a separate app text recommendation; no font file is embedded in the SVG masters.
